column3: MT 7:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; the term שִׁגָּיוֹן (“Shiggaion”) is rendered “A Meditation,” and “seek refuge” “put my trust.”
Close to the Hebrew; the singular “he” is rendered as plural “they.”
Close to the Hebrew; וָאֲחַלְּצָה (“I have rescued”) is rendered “have plundered.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my life” (soul) is rendered “me” in the first line.
Close to the Hebrew; “over it” is rendered “For their sakes,” and NKJV adds “therefore.”
Close to the Hebrew; וּכְלָיוֹת (“and kidneys”) is rendered “and minds.”
Close to the Hebrew; מָגִנִּי (“my shield”) is rendered “My defense.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “with the wicked.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “His sword… His bow,” taking God as subject.
Close to the Hebrew; “he is in labor with wickedness” is rendered “the wicked brings forth iniquity,” supplying “the wicked.”
